balls.text: has Bala finished with a four? No, it is stopped really well in the deep once again by Nagar. Length ball on the pads, Balaji splashes it away towards deep square leg and Nagar dives and saves. They run three. 20 overs done, not a single one of spin.

aha, the running has been funny this over. Lee's gone this time, despite the dive, which was poorly timed and he ended up sprawled at full stretch outside the crease. Tiwary again gets it away to the midwicket region and seemed content for one. Lee wanted to give the strike back and again rain almost halfway back before turning. Good throw from Nagar, and Ojha does the rest.
gets enough on this, forcing a full ball from Agarkar into the midwicket region. This is a good over so far.

haha! Lee runs nearly one and a half runs. And Tiwary goes nowhere. The ball goes nowhere either. Tiwary looks to pull, can't get bat on it, and it is stuck between the legs. Lee hares across, Tiwary sends him back. Agarkar coolly trots across and picks up the ball from where it is lodged. Everyone smiles.

Lee would have been out if Sehwag had hit the stumps. Lee squeezes the full ball back towards Agarkar, who can't collect and it goes to Sehwag at mid off. Lee screams past, and dives, but would have been short.
slower ball, comes on later than Tiwary expected and he guides the pull for a single.

Irfan has held another catch! And this one was pretty good too. RTD looks to hoist Morne over the covers this time, and ends up hitting it high into the night. Irfan runs in from deep point and holds on as he tumbles forward.

top shot. Morne keeps this full on off stump, inches away from a yorker than ball, and RTD spanks it back down the ground. He stood back in the crease to work the lengths there, and reaped the reward.

oh boy, I don't think I've seen a ball ever go so high. RTD jumps half forward, swings the bat in a wild circle and jabs the length ball into orbit. The Kotla crowd crinks its collective neck looking into the skies before the satellite begins its descent and lands just a couple of metres over the straight boundary. That got a lot of height, and enough distrance.
over-pitched on off stump, Tiwary stays back and drills it towards wide long on for a single.
again Tiwary moves too far away, and ends up struggling to reach a ball landed well outside off.
angling into the pads, RTD quietly works it square for one.
works a single off the pads towards square leg. Kolkata need a big finish here.

This could be four, or run out. Rare scenes, RTD drags a short of length ball to deep square leg, where Nagar does well to dive and intercept, but he slides close to the boundary. He then picks up and hurls to the bowler's end as RTD looks to run a third. Hopes relays it to the keeper and RTD is miles short. But replays show Nagar did not stop the boundary cleanly.
full-pitched on the toes, worked with the angle through square leg for a single
fullish offcutter on middle and coming in, Tiwary plays all over it and it trickles into the off side.
legcutter outside off, Hopes waits and dabs it backward of point for another single.
offcutter ends up a yorker on the toes, and it is flicked backward of square for a couple. Tardy fielding makes it easy.
Hopes slips an offcutter down the leg side. Wide called.
good ball to end a good spell, 145 kph and hurrying into the right hander, who dabs it into the off side.
short and a touch wide outside off, Tiwary plays this smartly, he softly redirects it into the covers and hares back for the second. An interesting 50 this.
he's given him some width outside off, and Tiwary carves it away towards third man
short of a length outside off stump, RTD dabs it through point for a single.
wide, too far outside off and called.
on the pads, full and worked away to midwicket for a single.
Umesh hits the deck hard again, a touch wide of off stump and Manoj swishes and misses.
with the new ball, this would have been out. This time it lands on off and doesn't quite bend back enough. Rapped on the pads, appealed and turned down. End of a fine spell from Irfan...
fuller ball on middle and off, driven down the ground for a single.
just enough room outside off for RTD to slash away backward of point for a single
RTD defends from the crease, not much movement for Irfan now.
Tiwary leans out to a ball outside off, and picks a single into the off side
played away in front of square. RTD is away, but Tiwary is key.

Quick Gun Morgan, gone before you noticed. This is really good bowling from Umesh, another short ball that comes along faster than the batsman expected. Morgan was clearly caught by surprise, and ended up losing the grip on the bat as he swung the pull. It went nowhere, and the keeper got under it.

Pathan c Pathan b Yadav. Umesh does well, again ensuring it's not full enough for the drive, and Yusuf goes for his patent muscled slam over long on. The ball is again onto him faster than he thought, and he ended up lofting it straight to Irfan at long on. Easy catch, but given whose it was, and that he's fielded badly today, Irfan would have felt the pressure. After all, big brother was watching.
width outside off, Tiwary dabs backward of point for one.
aha, tight, he plays straight to Sehwag at midwicket, and Yusuf backs up too far down before returning. A direct hit might have got him out.

how did that go for six? He was late on the front-foot hoicked pull, Umesh got it to hurry on him, and Tiwary ended up getting it away off the top edge. And it easily cleared wide long-on. This is a tennis court.
Big appeal from Umesh, but that was surely heading down. Length ball, comes in with the angle and Tiwary misses the flick. Onto the pad and rolls away to the off side.
back of length outside off, played into the off side. Slow start from Yusuf.
angled in on the pads, Tiwary taps a single to the leg side.
slower ball on the pads, Yusuf whips straight to Agarkar at short fine leg and goes for the single. The throw is fired in, Hopes quickly deflects it onto the stumps, but Yusuf is in.
Tiwary ambles across the stumps and nudges with the angle for a single through square leg
keeps it just outside off this time, Yusuf pushes at it from the crease, and gets a single.
this one slips too far down the leg side, and is called.
another bouncer from Hopes, angling in and Yusuf goes for the pull. He doesn't make contact, and it isn't wided either.
Morne finishes the over well, with a vicious angling inducker that cuts Tiwary in half. He somehow keeps it down.
width outside off, Tiwary reaches and steers but finds point.
back of a length on off stump, Yusuf dabs a single backward of point for a single. The throw from point thuds into him as he looks to complete the run. Ouch.
beats him first ball with a smart ball outside off that holds its line and hurries on. Yusuf feels inside the line and misses.
wisely lands this outside off, Tiwary dabs a single to point.

Tiwary has got stuck into a length ball from Morne Morkel here. He's hitting some brutal blows over the short leg side boundary. Morne' natural angle brings it in, and the leg side swipe is on, but Tiwary's timing there was immense.
full ball to finish off, Yusuf will have to wait for strike. Tiwary drives wide of mid-off for a single.

for the first time in it's history, the Kotla cheers Gambhir's exit. Hopes keeps it on a length around middle and leg at a friendly pace, Gambhir lines him up and looks to cart a six over deep midwicket, but ends up hitting it high rather than far. When it comes down, Venu at deep midwicket was under it.
Tiwary has played many shots for not so many runs. Plays a huge pull from well outside off and swivels 360 degree on impact. The ball squirts away without power to the leg side.
he goes the other way this time and looks to play the lap shot, and it runs away off the pads towards short fine leg side for one.
full and wide outside off, Gambhir gets too far away to the leg side and can't reach it.
Hopes keeps it full on off stump, Tiwary plays it into the leg side for a single.
another slower ball, this time at 112 kph and Tiwary pulls it with the deviation to deep backward square leg. Poor, poor over.
whoa, Gambhir looks to play the lap shot, Agarkar responds with a slower offcutter at 113 kph on middle and off, Gambhir changes the shot and dabs to point.
Gambhir looks to slam him through the off side, he comes out and looks to go big through the covers, but can't connect.

here comes the over-compensation, very short and well outside off. Tiwary opens the face and steers powerfully backward of point. Morne, from third man, does well to lope across and save the boundary.
Agarkar's bleeding now. Another leg-stump offering, Tiwary makes it worse by moving across and the whip-slaps him behind square leg for four more.
oh boy, Tiwary gets a piece of patent Agarkar tripe and smashed it out of Delhi. Full toss at a nice height, on the pads and he clubs it after moving across, easily over deep square leg.
Gambhir moves away, Hopes follows him and keeps it just outside leg, but Gambhir still manages to get the cover drive away for a single.
taps off the back foot to a length ball on off, and gets a single towards wide mid on
well outside off at 122 kph, Tiwary wafts at it without moving the feet at all, and can't get bat on it.
slower offcutter, dropped short and going away, Gambhir cuts it away for one.
Tiwary trots across, and nudges off the pads to the leg side for a single.
fullish ball on off stump, Tiwary is napping on the back foot and defends down the track.
and he begins with a bumper, Tiwary ducks under it.
that's as close to a wide as you will get without actually being called. Two feet outside off, Gambhir can't reach it from leg stump, though he swings hard. Not called.
gets this one shorter and it lifts onto Tiwary who is alert enough to dab it backward of square for one.
Agarkar is hitting his straps now. It's a day for seamers on a comeback trail. Another one darts away off the seam, and Tiwary pokes uncertainly
Gambhir hangs back and opens the face to steer a single backward of point.
Agarkar gets one to nip away a touch from a length, Tiwary taps into the off side and gets a single.
another almighty swing. And a miss. From Tiwary. He needs to settle down here.
good bouncer, Umesh has Gauti in strife with the short ball once again. Clocks at 134 kph but the length was immaculate. Gambhir ducks under it in a hurry.
another strange shot. Not too short and on off, Tiwary goes for a pull and toe-ends a single to the leg side.
now Tiwary motors down the track and looks for an ugly heave down the ground. The length's not there and he doesn't make contact.
short of a length outside off, he goes for a cut and misses.
leans into a forward defensive.

well, Irfan's bowling might be coming back, but his fielding is going the other way. Short and wide outside off, Tiwary cuts with some power straight to Irfan at deep backward point where he does the long barrier and lets it go through.
on the pads to end the over, Tiwary nudges square for a single.
fuller and wide outside off, Gambhir plays into the covers for another single.
the good old Gambhir walk in the park. He strolls out on leg stump line, converts a length ball into a half-volley and whips it over midwicket
angled across Gauti, who opens the face and drives solidly into the mid-off area.
Tiwary is away, drives in front of square and gets a single
more vintage Agarkar. Wide down the leg side

Drumroll. Agarkar has struck first ball. And it might a poor decision. Unlucky for Goswami, who looks unhappy. Agarkar's knack for picking up wickets continues, even when the batsman is not actually out. No wait. The replay suggests he edged it. Full and wide outside off, Goswami looks to steer and it looked like he nicked it after all. Ojha completes the catch.

oho, Irfan's made his first mistake of the day. He's put down a tough chance from Gambhir. Short and pacy from Umesh, 146 kph and rising at some pace, and Gambhir top-edges the pull backward of square leg. Irfan runs back, looks to pouch as it comes down over his head, and drops. Never looked like taking it.
stand and deliver. Gambhir gets a foot of room outside off, sets up a solid base on leg stump and smashed it through the covers with a hint of disdain.
on the pads, nudges it away square for a single.
Goswami backs away and ends up too far from the ball. He finally reaches it and cuts without power to point
back of a length and angling across, played backward of point for a single.
full at 138 kph outside off, Gambhir drives without really moving into it, and plays straight to cover.

vicious from Irfan, and Goswami can be proud that he even got bat on that. It landed on leg stump, moved away like a yo-yo and took the outside edge as it was headed to slip. The edge was thick enough to take it away from Sehwag at the lone slip. What a spell from Irfan!
straighter from Irfan, Gambhir pushes it from the pads towards mid-on for his first run.
Gambhir skates out first ball and looks to crack him through the covers! Hits it hard, but finds Venu in the covers.

Irfan's classical inducker has struck, but not the way you would expect it to. As always it lands on off and middle and curls in, searching for the bat-pad gap, but Kallis has bounded outside off stump already. He ends up well outside and looks to flick as the ball moves in sharply, and Kallis' glance can't make contact. Leg stump. Clatter.
lift for Irfan, surprises Kallis as he hurries onto the back foot to defend to the off side.

Run out appeal, and Goswami is struggling. He's just got in, though. Fuller ball and moving away from Goswami, who tips and runs. The fielder, Rao, prances in from cover, picks up and shoots down the stumps at the bowler's end. Just in.
Morne tightens the line and length, fuller and angling into Kallis who defends down the track.

154.6 kph, short and just a touch wide outside off. Kallis trots out again and murders it over point. It was short and rising as he met it with a vicious cross-batted slam. Up and over, six runs on this mickey-mouse outfield. Top shot.

risky but Kallis pulls it off. He might have tried this against Morne in the South Africa nets. He jumps out and to the leg side, making room to loft inside out, and then forces it between the covers for four.
this one is a touch wider of the stumps, Goswami rides the bounce and plays it into the off side

shot of the day from Goswami. 144 kph, back of a length and not there to be driven. Goswami gets the half step forward, meets the ball and thumps it on the rise over a quickly ducking Kallis' head, and it pistols away to long off.
top ball from Morne, lands one on a length on off stump and watches the fun as it buzzes past the shoulder of Goswami's bat. Big lift.
finally Goswami gets behind the line, and defends from middle and off towards mid-on for a pinched single.
now he backs away and looks to slash, but again the ball is in another zip code as Irfan continues to banana it away.
Goswami goes fishing. Only salmons of doubt for him. Irfan again gets it to curl away.
this time Kallis gets the single, flicking with the movement towards midwicket

did he get an edge there? Kallis again moves the front foot well across and the ball bends in sharply, Kallis is cramped as he looks to drive and it goes off the pad. No inside edge, and through to the keeper.
Kallis tries to counter the swing by walking across the stumps and looking for the on side, but can't get it away.

top shot from Goswami, he stays put on leg stump and has enough room to free the arms through the off side. Morne keeps it wide enough outside off for the scythed cut over point. Goswami plays it well.
good shot, but well fielded at point. Morne gives width and length, Goswami reaches half across and throws his bat at a square drive. He finds point.
and now Goswami pulls out his Ganguly impersonation, moving the front foot away to the leg side to open up the off side and then carves Morne with his pace and bounce through third man.
fuller on off, Goswami gets half forward and defends into the off side

Goswami tries to do his Lara impersonation, swaggering away from the stumps and looking for a slashed cover drive off the back foot. Morne responds with his Garner impersonation. Morne wins. Swing and a miss.
angled across on a length from over the wicket, Goswami leans out to defend into the off side
Morne begins with a big wide down the leg side
good first over from Irfan, will have to see if he can keep it going as the ball gets slightly older. Again that away movement from the left hander as Goswami carefully steers to third man

dropped by Warner, would you believe it! Irfan starts the swing too straight and this deviates onto Kallis' pads, but he is unable to keep the flick down. Warner at midwicket comes forward, lunges and tries to pouch but spills it.
Irfan's got that swing going in the first over, comes in drastically and Kallis adjusts to play it back down the track
this time too straight, ends up on the hips and Goswami tucks it square for one
lovely ball. Irfan special, circa 2003. Comes in with the angle, lands outside off and bends away magically. Better batsmen have fallen to it, but Goswami doesn't edge as he pokes.
and he gets the first one to curve in from well outside off, and kick off from just back of a length at 126 kph. Kallis stands back and guides square

Delhi have lost five games. Not good for them. Yadav drives the last ball to mid-off for a single. Not close to enough. The Kotla bustles without the kind of energy that was there earlier in the day. Finally, Gambhir has a half-smile.
Nagar is gone now, he's not timed the pull to another slower bouncer, he looked to swat it from well outside off, and ended up popping it to the keeper.
Morne gets a single, not enough. Full and straight, played without timing past mid-off for a single.
Bala wisely keeps it as wide outside off as possible. Morne backs away, and despite his height he can't reach this.
lucky, Morne squeezes a low full toss outside off down to third man. He just flailed at it wildly, and it ran away to the fence.
dot ball to start off, Morkel misses a slower ball that comes in IPL 2012. Swing and a miss.

Nagar knows the conventional is not working, so he tries the unconventional. He moves across the stumps and looks to paddle a full and fast ball outside off. He ends up playing it right back at Lee who collects and menaces him with a mock charge, as if he's going to hurl his stumps down. Nagar backs away. Take a bow, Brett Lee.
Morne gets an unplayable yorker. He meekly defends to the off side for one. Lee has won it for them with a top over.
Nagar pushes a single in front of square. No hat-trick of run outs.

another duck for Agarkar. Lee sends down another thunderbolt yorker outside off, Nagar squeezes to mid off, Agarkar has hared halfway down before turning back. Easier collection and finish from Lee this time.

Lee, you champion. He's produces a one-of-a-kind run-out, seemed like a scene out of NBA this. Length ball outside off, Venu goes for a big swipe and misses. Nagar comes for the single, Venu responds, the keeper collects, Lee arrests his follow through and back pedals towards the non-striker's stumps. The throw is looped in high, Lee leaps up to collect, and then twists mid-air and then slam-dunks the stumps down from a big height. Venu was stuck behind Lee, not that he even had a chance of making his crease. Spectacular.
and what a ball to start with. Yorker, six inches outside off and very fast. Venu can't get bat on it.

Oh boy, Delhi haven't given up yet. Nagar lands a telling blow. Length from Bala, he keeps doing this all the time. Nagar keeps the front foot out of the way to ensure it is in the slot, and then up-and-overs it beyond extra cover. Game, not over.
top-notch yorker, on the toes, and Venu digs it out to the off side just for a single.
short and wide, crucial boundary for DD, Venu carves it over the covers and even Kallis can't stop this.
Kallis is everywhere. Now he's sweeping on the covers. Full ball on the off stump, Venu times it really well towards point and the sweeper Kallis cuts it off again.
full and straight on the pads, Venu drills it straight to mid-off and thinks of one. Nagar doesn't and they decide not to run in the end.
slow loopy short ball, foxes the batsman as he moves across looking for a lap shot, and the keeper. They run a bye as Shrrevats tumbles and fails to collect.
well bowled Unadkat. Full ball on off, Venu plays it back to the bowler.
another good shot from Nagar, muscular whip off the pads and it seemed headed for the deep midwicket fence until Kallis came in the way, once again. They run three.
and again, even better. Nagar scoots out and looks to guide, but can't squeeze it away.
smart. He knows Nagar is backing away, and keeps it well outside off but just inside the tramlines. He can't reach it.
Nagar! He's bashed a short ball miles over that 55-m long boundary over square leg. That cleared the ropes so easily, it wasn't even funny. Murderous pull.
angling across outside off, dabbed cautiously to third man. They can't afford caution anymore.
stabs the last ball towards point, and they take another dodgy single. Another direct hit could have posed problems.
Venu forces a chipped steer between point and cover, it was uppish but safe. Kallis does well sweeping, to save the boundary with a dive. The fielding has been good today from KKR.
back of a length outside off, Nagar rides it towards third man with an angled face.
slow bouncer, Nagar had no clue what it was going, and Umpire Reiffel calls it wide for height.
bouncer, too wide outside off and it is called.

bombards Nagar with a bumper, and he pushes an iffy single to the leg side. Almost a run out, Lee runs after it, collects at throws at the stumps but he misses. One over throw taken, Yusuf backs up well to limit the damage.
deft. Slower ball, Venu spots it late and belatedly chooses to dab it away to third man for one more.
lovely hit from Venu. Unfurls a sprightly inside out drive through wide mid-off, and Yusuf dives over it after making good ground.
Venu tries to sweep from outside off, against the spin. Did he get anything on it? Not called a leg bye, single to the off side.

Ojha combusts. He's not managed to get to the pitch of the ball, or cover for the spin. He's just blindly hoicked Abdulla into the Kotla night, and Lee settles down under it, well inside the straight boundary.
Venu carves inside out for another single to the deep cover for a single.
plays the first ball with the spin into the covers for one.

KKR move closer to the win. Hopes is gone now, cutting a short ball outside off straight to cover. He's hardly come forward, and is probably hampered by the injury. He's just hacked this half-tracker straight to cover.
Hopes goes downtown, and Delhi need more of those. He moves the back foot across, gets into a lovely position and launches him against the spin over long on.
tossed up for a change, he's early on the flick and finds short midwicket
short ball, Hopes slams the pull but finds deep square leg
again on the pads, worked with the spin to the leg side
On the pads, worked with the turn to the leg side.
Rao is the new man in, and he defends the first ball to the leg side
Delhi are sinking. Birt bites the dirt. Yusuf gets him with another fired-in short ball. Birt went for the pull but that hurried on him, and he ended up lofting straight to Shakib at deep midwicket.
only nine from the over as Birt guides another ball towards backward point for one. Where is the in-form Venugopal?
Hopes forces one past the bowler to long-on for one more.
aha, did he get anything on that? No. More sharp turn for Abdulla, Hopes lookes sheepish after swinging straight and misses as it turns away from him. They run two byes.
on middle stump, he leans across and nudges another single behind square. They need a couple of boundaries to make this a really good over.
Hopes forces into the covers, and Warner shows his worth by running for him at double quick speed. They get a couple.
on the pads, Birt plays it softly through square leg and they get a couple.
straightens from the stumps, he drives solidly down the ground for one more
fuller ball, steered straight to point. Birt is under pressure, he wanders out and then comes back in late after being refused the single.
fired in at 95 kph, Birt defends quietly
this one turns too much down the leg side, and Hopes whips square for one more.
this one skids on from round the stumps, Birt deflects to the leg side for one more
full on the stumps, flicked fluently to midwicket for one
this one straightens from off stump, and Birt is cramped as he looks to steer. Played straight to point. KKR on top.
gets one on the pads first up, and glances straight to short fine leg.
fullish ball on the leg stump line, worked down to long on for one.

this time, no Pathan c Pathan. This time, it is Pathan c RTD. Looks like Irfan was the designated attacker in this stand, he skated out to the first ball of spin he was facing and looked to cart him with the spin over midwicket. Didn't hit it well enough, and RTD settled under it in the deep.
works a length ball against the spin towards midwicket.
sharp turn again from outside off, played with the spin into the covers.
Irfan hits an important six, as Kallis lands one on a length around off stump. Irfan is pleased to finally get one in his half, gets under it and launches it over long-off. Good hit.
slow offcutting bouncer at 116 kph. Irfan never looked like he figured when that was coming and ended up feeling for it after it left him.
over-pitched outside off, Irfan tries to winkle the square drive away but still no luck with the placement.
again, Kallis keeps it short of a length and Irfan goes for the pull. Mistimed again, they are all going into the pull late.
Hopes moves the front foot out of the way and looks to cross-bat down the ground. He mistimes the shot down towards mid-off
over-pitched on the pads, whipped straight to midwicket.
fuller and draws him out into the steered drive towards point.
keeps this one outside off, short of a length and played towards the covers for no run.
it's just 129 kph, but Unadkat's lines are impeccable. Irfan takes no risk, he just ducks under it.
these Unadkat bouncers and coming on faster than the batsmen are expecting. Hopes gets one on the glove this time, miscuing the pull backward of square leg.
the pressure releases a touch, as Hopes mows another tight ball, just past midwicket in the circle. He did not time the shot well, but got it to the right of the fielder.
short of a length and hurries onto Hopes who works it to the leg side
another full ball on the stumps, driven to long-on for one more.
offcutter finishes on off stump, Irfan drops it to the off side for a single
full and straight on the toes, Hopes drives wide of mid-on for a single.
short ball, comes on in uneasy fashion as Hopes looks for a swat-pull. Can't time it.
short of a length on off and middle, Hopes gets behind the line and defends down the track.
fullish ball on the pads, worked into the leg side for a single.

missed run out. Irfan pokes into the off side and hurries across, Unadkat follows through well, goes down and swivels as he picks it up, and has a go, but misses the stumps. Hopes would have been gone if he had hit.
Unadkat delivers a peach, outside off and a hint of shape away. Irfan feels and misses.

Unadkat has picked up the most important wicket of the day. He's got Sehwag on the pull, with another serious bouncer. 134 kph, hurries onto Sehwag who this time goes for the shot. He was clearly late on it, and ended up top-edging as it got big on him. Fine leg was waiting.
nice bouncer. 133 kph only, but the line and the length are spot on from over the wicket. Sehwag weaves away.
over-pitched, Hopes reaches across and smashes it straight. Lee does well to run across from long off and keep it to one.
Unadkat keeps it outside off and Sehwag again looks to drive hard down the ground. He gets an inside edge into the leg side for one
fuller and outside off, Sehwag steers for a single through point.
normal service. Short ball on off stump, Sehwag carts it against the spin through wide mid on for four.

another monster ball. Goswami looks utterly befuddled after jumping around like a confused puppy watching two parallel games of Ultimate frisbee. It breaks away like a fiend, Sehwag looks to dab and then pulls out of it.
he gets a single this time, playing him down the ground.

everyone's caught by surprise. Abdulla's dropped a return catch. It stopped on Hopes who was looking to force into thew off side and he patted it right back down the track. Abdulla was wrong footed and could not arrest the momentum enough to catch it. Sehwag was scrambling back in, in a hurry.
saner ball, he gets behind the line and defends to mid-off

and you wonder why no other tweaker is playing. Abdulla ambles in, lands it outside off and gets it to rip away a mile and a half. Hopes looks like he just saw a ghost. Shreevats did well to get a glove to it.
the line has got worse right through the over, and he finishes with a rubbish ball on Sehwag's pads. Easily glanced past short fine leg.
this one lands outside leg and hence it doesn't matter that he got it to move away, Hopes was always inside the line and flicked it away square.
straighter this time, Hopes tries to nurdle to the leg side, but finds the fielder
short of a length, Hopes stays back and defends down the track.
superb ball, Unadkat gets one to jag away off the seam and Hopes is in some trouble as he looks to pull the bat away from it.
127 kph on that uneasy length outside off, Sehwag still goes for a big drive and mistimes to the leg side
stays on the crease and forces a short of length ball towards extra cover for a single.
straight again, on the pads, Sehwag whips with a flourish but finds the fielder at midwicket
better line, comes in and finishes on off stump and Sehwag plays it into the off side

that ball made its way to the fence at Mach 3. Again a touch of width outside off, Sehwag stays beside the line and clatters it away backward of point, this time along the turf. Where that bat speed came from, only Sehwag knows.

you can keep a sweeper at cover, and bowl to that field, but that won't stop Sehwag from going for that boundary. If he can't find a way past that fielder, he will look for a way over him. Back of a length outside off, Sehwag wades into an emphatic on-the-up cover blast and it clears the fielder there.
Bala angles in from wide of the crease, Hopes stays on the crease and works it with the angle towards square leg.
fuller, Hopes punches wide of mid-off for a single. Slow start for Delhi.
short of a length outside off, Hopes tries to cut but is early on the shot and gets it straight to cover.
aha, Sehwag goes for that upper cut, and gets it away well, but there is third man. Doesn't carry though, he did not throw everything at it.
mistimed again, Lee keeps it very full on off stump and Sehwag inside-edges this time to mid-on. Needs to tighten up.
full and fast at 143 kph, Sehwag doesn't time the off drive and it goes off the outside half to wide mid-off
Lee lands this on the pads, and Sehwag whips on the hop straight to midwicket.

that's the end of Warner, he's not looked himself in the last couple of games. Again stuck pre-meditatedly on the back foot, and goes for a compulsive cut though Balaji kept this very tight outside off. The resultant under edge crashed into the stumps. Bala is chuffed.
another one well outside off, Sehwag slashes straight to the sweeper.
Warner is on the backfoot again, stifled appeal from Bala, but this landed outside leg before hitting him in line. Leg bye taken.
brave from Bala, gives him more width and Sehwag goes in the air. There is protection at deep cover this time, though.

don't give him width. Not even half a foot. You give him half a foot, he'll take a mile. Back of a length and marginally outside off, Sehwag waits for it to come beside him and them whiplashes it between point and cover.
starts with a gentle length ball at 133 kph, Sehwag is onto the check drive early and it pops up to the left of the bowler
ends the over with another one full and straight on the pads, Warner plays cautiously to the leg side
on a length, on the pads this time, and Warner works it to the leg side
he's got some nice movement going, into the left hander at 142 kph. Warner plays from the crease and just manages to keep it out. Will want to get forward to these.
and that's a good comeback, Lee gets the legcutter to square up Sehwag, and the leading edge runs away behind point for one
Boom. Lee has been Sehwag-ed through the covers. Short of a length out side off. Sehwag sees ball, stays put on leg stump, and flays ball. Disdain written all over it.
tight run thing, and they are away. Warner pushes into the covers and they scoot across.
pacy but well outside off, it is called a wide as he leaves.
